
                                                            Example Service (SYNTHETIC)
                                                            Rate Schedule SYN-1


         I. Applicability
               This SYNTHETIC Rate Schedule SYN-1 applies to example premises only.
                  1. Example customers with an example meter installed are eligible.
                  2. Example customers without an example meter are not eligible.

               A. Example Rate (rate category SYN01)
                  1. This is a SYNTHETIC rate that exists only to exercise the parser.
                  2. No customer is billed under it and no utility publishes it.

         III. Example Options
               A. Example Surcharge. Refer to Rate Schedule SYN-HGA.

               B. Example Standby Option
                    Example Standby Charge - January 1 through December 31
                    ($/kW of Example Capacity per month)
                          Effective May 1, 2026           $1.234
                          Effective January 1, 2027       $2.345

               C. Example Vehicle Credit (rate category SYN01)
                    Credit applies to all example usage charges from midnight to 6:00 a.m. daily.
                          Example Vehicle Credit            -$0.0100/kWh

         IV. Example Billing Periods
               A. Example Time-of-Day Billing Periods

                                    Peak              Weekdays between 5:00 p.m. and 8:00 p.m.
        Example Summer
                                    Mid-Peak          Weekdays between noon and midnight except during the Peak hours.
        (Mar 1 - Apr 30)
                                    Off-Peak          All other hours, including weekends and holidays.
        Example Winter              Peak              Weekdays between 5:00 p.m. and 8:00 p.m.
        (May 1 - Feb 28)            Off-Peak          All other hours, including weekends and holidays.

               Off-Peak pricing shall apply during the following holidays:

                    Holiday                         Month             Date
                    Example New Year Day            January           1
                    Example Spring Day              March             Third Monday
